app.name: CivicLens AI
app.notice: Academic prototype — not an official government portal.

preview.title: A clearer lens on civic workflows.
preview.lead: A shared visual foundation for multilingual civic intelligence—where AI recommends, people decide, and every decision stays accountable.
preview.positioningBody: CivicLens adds an intelligence and accountability layer to existing complaint workflows. It does not replace the services people already use.
preview.intelligence: Understand → Extract → Classify → Prioritise → Route → Detect related issues → Monitor SLA → Escalate → Verify resolution → Audit AI decisions
preview.principlesTitle: Trust is part of the interface.
preview.aiRecommendsBody: Recommendations show an estimated confidence, plain-language reason, and model version. Low confidence is sent for human review.
preview.originalSacredBody: The citizen’s exact text is preserved. Normalised text is a separate, clearly identified derived value.
preview.citizenVerificationBody: Staff submit a proposed resolution. Only the citizen can accept it; rejection reopens the case and records a reason.
preview.auditableBody: The append-only audit history records original AI values, human changes, reasons, actor, and time.
preview.tokensTitle: One foundation. Light, dark, and RTL.
preview.tokensBody: Switch themes and direction to check the palette, typography, spacing, depth, and motion before building product screens.
preview.typeUrduBody: شہری کی شکایت کو سمجھیں اور واضح جواب دیں۔
preview.typeRomanBody: Gali mein pani jama hai, barah-e-karam madad karein.
preview.typeRomanNote: Roman Urdu remains ordinary left-to-right Latin text.
preview.motionHint: Motion respects reduced-motion preferences and animates transform or opacity.
preview.sampleCardBody: A shared card shows surface, border, radius, depth, and readable contrast.
